t: Founded in 1347 when Deccan nobles rebelled against Muhammad bin Tughluq and proclaimed Bahman Shah sultan.
Its Persianate court ruled from Gulbarga and Bidar and fought Vijayanagara for 150 years over the Raichur Doab.
After Mahmud Gawan's execution in 1481 its governors broke away, founding the five Deccan sultanates.
dyk: The Russian merchant Afanasy Nikitin stayed in Bidar around 1470 and wrote one of the earliest European descriptions of the Bahmani court and its people.
ev: Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah is proclaimed sultan at Daulatabad
The Jama Masjid in Gulbarga fort is built
Firuz Shah is defeated by Vijayanagara at Pangal
Ahmad Shah I moves the capital to Bidar
Mahmud Gawan's forces take Goa and his madrasa at Bidar is built
Mahmud Gawan is executed on a forged charge of treason
The governors of Bijapur, Ahmadnagar and Berar become independent
The last Bahmani sultan, Kalimullah, flees Bidar

f.successor: Deccan sultanates (Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, Golconda, Berar, Bidar)
